item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('caught-up.svg')
r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
assert r.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 160 128'
s = r.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}style').text
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in s
assert '* { animation: none "'!important; }'"' in s
assert '0%, 35%, 100%' in s
assert not any(x.tag.endswith(('script', 'image', 'foreignObject')) for x in r.iter())
print(f'Valid standalone SVG; {p.stat().st_size} bytes; seamless loop and reduced-motion fallback present.')
PY"
